expectations.name: autofix-bulk-applies-errata
expected_behavior: Acts on nothing outside the `## Errata` block: no mechanical issue absent from it is fixed, and the SRD is not re-scanned for new ones

Runs neither the glossary resolution nor the approval gate — errata touch neither ids nor terms — so no approval-gate status line and no glossary question reach the user, and no `glossary_terms` call is made; the closing manifest's status follow-up is not a gate line
Lists the three substitutions and takes one confirmation for the whole batch, not the per-change loop
Verifies each `old` at its anchor, applies the two that match exactly once, and reports the third as stale rather than guessing where it belongs
Writes no review file and invokes no `review` run; prints the exact hand-off command `review initiatives/payload-booking/srd.md check #n,n`, scoped to the two applied errata, for the user to run
Closes with a manifest naming what was applied, what was skipped and why, and the findings handed to `check` — not what `check` later did with them

expectations.name: corpus-grounded-edit-routes-the-unconfirmable
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before accepting the edit, and the draft gap it hands over names the queries tried
Captures the gap with `srd:report-doc-gap` as a draft silently — no interruption and no grilling mid-edit
States the retry count as a fact inside the proposal, so the user's `YN` attests it and `srd:kb` receives it — the fact is in front of the user when the key is pressed, not looked up afterwards
Asks no separate "bank this?" question
Hands the unconfirmable claim to `srd:report-doc-gap` and the attested fact to `srd:kb`, and neither interrupts the edit in progress

expectations.name: feedback-without-a-review-file
expected_behavior: Says the review file is absent and stops: `#n` names a finding only a review file can carry
Invents no findings and proposes no edit of its own, even though the SRD has real defects
Leaves `initiatives/payload-booking/srd.md` unchanged and writes no decision log
Says it in one or two lines naming the missing file, and reports nothing about its own start — no approval-gate line, no draft-check result, no closing manifest
Offers no menu of other ways in (run `review`, paste findings, drop the argument): the user asked for a finding number, and the answer is that there are none

expectations.name: autofix-inserts-missing-notice
expected_behavior: Inserts the Conventions section with the notice exactly once, where the standard places it: directly after the Introduction and ahead of `## Boundaries`, not below the header table
Applies the ordinary substitution in the same batch
Hands the insertion to `check` with the other applied finding: `review initiatives/payload-booking/srd.md check #4,10`

expectations.name: autofix-misplaced-notice-is-stale
expected_behavior: Inserts no second notice and adds no Conventions section: the SRD still holds exactly one notice, left where it was below the header table
Reports `#10` as stale — a notice already exists, and moving a misplaced one is not errata
Applies `#4` and hands only it to `check`: `review initiatives/payload-booking/srd.md check #4`

expectations.name: summary-default-newest-block
expected_behavior: Covers only the newest block: the 14-day swap deadline and the 21-day cutoff appear, the earlier block's PB-1 change does not
Links the SW-2 line to #8 in trailing parentheses and never names #3, the older finding on the same id
Lists withdrawn #9 (stamped inside the newest block's span) and neither #4 (stamped in the earlier block's span) nor the unstamped #2
Puts the PB-3 rewording only in a closing `Wording` section, after every group of changes in meaning
Opens with the header line `Payload Booking: changes 2026-09-30 15:20` and uses no Markdown: no asterisks, backticks, or `#` headings
Writes no file: no Write or Edit call, the decision log and review file included
Groups the changes under the SRD's own requirement group names, `Booking Requests` and `Slot Swaps`, each on its own line
Names no open finding the selection did not touch: #12 is absent

expectations.name: summary-merges-a-day
expected_behavior: Opens with the header line `Payload Booking: changes 2026-09-30`, with no time
Covers both 2026-09-30 blocks: the PB-1 change and the 14-day swap deadline both appear
Reports PB-2 once, by its end state: the 21-day cutoff appears once and the 28-day cutoff not at all
Lists withdrawn #4 and #9, both stamped on 2026-09-30, and not the unstamped #2
Leaves out the 2026-09-29 block: #3 is not named
Writes no file: no Write or Edit call
